default.sql: SELECT id, source_id, page_slug, page_id, filename, storage_path, mime_type, size_bytes, content_hash, metadata, created_at FROM files WHERE source_id = $1 AND storage_path = $2 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, source_id, page_slug, page_id, filename, storage_path, mime_type, size_bytes, content_hash, metadata, created_at FROM files WHERE page_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC

INSERT INTO files (source_id, page_slug, page_id, filename, storage_path, mime_type, size_bytes, content_hash, metadata) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) ON CONFLICT (storage_path) DO UPDATE SET page_slug = EXCLUDED.page_slug, page_id = EXCLUDED.page_id, filename = EXCLUDED.filename, mime_type = EXCLUDED.mime_type, size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes, content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata RETURNING id, (xmax = 0) AS created
